fallback.title: No devices found
fallback.description: No Airfi devices were found automatically. You can try discovery again or add a device manually.

fallback_error.title: Discovery failed
fallback_error.description: Could not start device discovery because the network socket is unavailable (port may be in use by another process). You can try again or add a device manually.

manual.title: Manual setup
manual.description: If you need help with the configuration, have a look at the [documentation]({documentation_url}).

data_description.host: The IP address of the Airfi device on your local network.
data_description.serial_number: Enter it exactly as shown on the device's type plate, in the Airfi app or web interface, or in the list of discovered devices if the search found the device. Home Assistant uses it to find the device again if its IP address changes and the search can reach it.
data_description.model_name: Pick the model shown on the device's type plate, such as Model 60, or the exact model name from the Airfi app. The model names the device in Home Assistant, and its entity IDs are formed from that name.

discovery_select.title: Select discovered device
discovery_select.description: Found {count} Airfi device(s). Select one to continue.

data_description.device: Each device is listed with its model, IP address, and serial number. The last two entries search the network again or let you add a device manually.

discovery_confirm.title: Confirm device
discovery_confirm.description:
**{model}** at {host} (serial: {serial})

Optionally give the device a custom name.

data_description.name: Leave empty to use the default name.

reconfigure.description: Update the connection settings for this integration.

data_description.host: The IP address at which the Airfi device can be reached now.

progress.discovering_devices: Searching your network for Airfi devices. This may take 5 to 15 seconds.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to the device.
error.cannot_retrieve_data: Unable to retrieve data from the device.

abort.invalid_selection: The selected device is no longer available.

data_description.update_interval_seconds: How often to refresh data from the device (5 to 60 seconds)

device_unreachable.message: Unable to connect to device at {host}.

setup_firmware_error.message: Device firmware version {firmware_version} is not supported by this integration.

update_failed.message: Failed to update data from the device.

update_failed_rediscovery.message: Device was rediscovered but data refresh still failed.

first_refresh_failed.message: Could not load initial data from the device at {host}.

setup_invalid_device_data.message: Failed to retrieve valid device data from the air handling unit. Check that it is powered on and connected to the network.

write_failed.message: Could not send the command to the Airfi unit: the write to register {register} failed.

write_failed_unreachable.message: Could not send the command to the Airfi unit at {host}: the unit did not respond.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the device at this IP address.
error.cannot_retrieve_data: Connected to the device but could not read required data.

init.title: {name} is unreachable
init.description: Update the IP address for {name} if it has changed. If the IP address has not changed, keep the current value and verify the device/network connection.

data_description.host: The IP address at which the Airfi device can be reached now.

unsupported_firmware.title: {name} has unsupported firmware ({firmware_version})
unsupported_firmware.description:
The device firmware version {firmware_version} is not compatible with this integration. Please update or downgrade the device firmware to a supported version.

For more information on updating your device firmware, please refer to support section on [Airfi website]({airfi_url}) (**airfi.fi/en** → **Support** → **Software update**).
